title: ID0391197-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000] Charging session interrupted
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charging process interrupted
Root cause: Input power issue.
Solution: F
ixed input power 151 kW instead of 160 kW.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active
